mechanism: Modafinil induces CYP3A4, reducing diltiazem metabolism and increasing its plasma concentrations, while diltiazem may inhibit modafinil metabolism via CYP3A4, creating bidirectional enzyme interaction.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and signs of diltiazem toxicity (bradycardia, hypotension, AV block); consider diltiazem dose reduction or alternative stimulant if concurrent use necessary.
